points.title: as ... as ... 和…一样
points.explanation_zh: 表示两者程度相同：as + 形容词/副词原级 + as。否定式 not as/so ... as 表示「不如」。

examples.en: She runs as fast as her brother.
examples.zh: 她跑得和她哥哥一样快。

examples.en: This book is not as interesting as that one.

points.title: 比较级 + than
points.explanation_zh: 两者比较用比较级加 than。比较级前可用 much / a little / even 修饰程度。

examples.en: This problem is much easier than the last one.
examples.zh: 这道题比上一道容易得多。

points.title: the more ..., the more ... 越…越…
points.explanation_zh: 「the + 比较级, the + 比较级」表示一方随另一方程度变化。

examples.en: The more you practice, the better you speak.

points.title: so ... that ... 如此…以至于
points.explanation_zh: so + 形容词/副词 + that 从句，表示结果。so 后面接形容词或副词，接名词时要用 such。

examples.en: He was so tired that he fell asleep at once.
examples.zh: 他太累了，立刻就睡着了。

points.title: such ... that ... 如此…以至于
points.explanation_zh: such + (a/an) + 形容词 + 名词 + that 从句。名词是复数或不可数时不加冠词。

examples.en: It was such a good film that I watched it twice.
examples.zh: 这部电影太好看了，我看了两遍。

points.title: so that 以便（目的状语）
points.explanation_zh: so that 引导目的状语从句，从句中常用 can / could / may / might。

examples.en: Speak louder so that everyone can hear you.
examples.zh: 说大声点，好让大家都能听见。

points.title: too ... to ... 太…而不能
points.explanation_zh: too + 形容词/副词 + to do，形式肯定、意义否定。

examples.en: The box is too heavy to carry.

points.title: enough to do 足以…
points.explanation_zh: enough 修饰形容词/副词时放在其后：adj./adv. + enough + to do。修饰名词时放在名词前。

examples.en: He is old enough to go to school.

points.title: not only ... but also ... 不但…而且…
points.explanation_zh: 连接两个并列成分；连接主语时谓语与靠近的主语一致（就近原则）。not only 位于句首时句子要部分倒装。

examples.en: She is not only smart but also hardworking.

points.title: both ... and ... 两者都
points.explanation_zh: 连接两个并列成分，作主语时谓语用复数。

examples.en: Both Tom and Jerry like cheese.
examples.zh: 汤姆和杰瑞都喜欢奶酪。

points.title: either ... or ... 要么…要么…
points.explanation_zh: 表示两者选其一；作主语时谓语与靠近的主语一致（就近原则）。

examples.en: Either you or I am wrong.

points.title: neither ... nor ... 既不…也不…
points.explanation_zh: 表示两者都否定；作主语时谓语与靠近的主语一致（就近原则）。

examples.en: Neither he nor his parents were at home.

points.title: would rather 宁愿
points.explanation_zh: would rather do sth. 宁愿做某事；would rather do A than do B 宁愿做 A 也不做 B。

examples.en: I would rather stay home than go out in the rain.
examples.zh: 我宁愿待在家里也不愿冒雨出门。

points.title: prefer A to B 更喜欢 A
points.explanation_zh: prefer + 名词/doing + to + 名词/doing，表示两者中更喜欢前者；prefer to do rather than do 也常用。

examples.en: I prefer tea to coffee.

points.title: used to / be used to / be used for
points.explanation_zh: used to do 过去常常做（现在不做了）；be/get used to doing 习惯于做；be used for doing 被用来做。三者含义完全不同，注意区分。

examples.en: I used to get up early.
She is used to living alone.

points.title: as soon as 一…就…
points.explanation_zh: 引导时间状语从句；主句是将来时时，从句用一般现在时表将来（主将从现）。

examples.en: I'll call you as soon as I arrive.

points.title: hardly ... when ... 刚…就…
points.explanation_zh: hardly + 过去完成时 + when + 一般过去时。hardly 位于句首时要部分倒装。

examples.en: Hardly had I sat down when the phone rang.

points.title: no sooner ... than ... 一…就…
points.explanation_zh: no sooner + 过去完成时 + than + 一般过去时；no sooner 位于句首时要部分倒装。

examples.en: No sooner had he left than it began to rain.

points.title: It takes sb. + 时间 + to do 花费
points.explanation_zh: It takes/took sb. + 时间 + to do sth. 表示做某事花某人多少时间。spend / cost / pay 的搭配各不相同。

examples.en: It took me two hours to finish the homework.
examples.zh: 我花了两个小时完成作业。

points.title: spend ... on / (in) doing 花费
points.explanation_zh: sb. spend + 时间/钱 + on sth. 或 + (in) doing sth.。主语必须是人，这一点与 it takes / sth. costs 不同。

examples.en: She spends an hour reading every day.

points.title: there be 存在句
points.explanation_zh: 表示「某地有某物」；be 与靠近的名词保持一致（就近原则）。注意与 have（拥有）区分。

examples.en: There is a book and two pens on the desk.
examples.zh: 桌上有一本书和两支钢笔。

points.title: have been to / have gone to
points.explanation_zh: have been to 去过（人已回来）；have gone to 去了（人还没回来）。

examples.en: He has been to Paris twice.
He has gone to Paris.
examples.zh: 他去巴黎了（人不在这里）。

points.title: stop doing / stop to do
points.explanation_zh: stop doing 停止正在做的事；stop to do 停下来去做另一件事。

examples.en: He stopped smoking last year.
He stopped to smoke.

points.title: remember doing / remember to do
points.explanation_zh: remember doing 记得做过某事（已发生）；remember to do 记得要去做某事（未发生）。

examples.en: I remember locking the door.
Remember to lock the door.

points.title: forget doing / forget to do
points.explanation_zh: forget doing 忘记做过某事（事已做）；forget to do 忘记去做某事（事没做）。

examples.en: Don't forget to send the email.

points.title: look forward to doing 期待
points.explanation_zh: look forward to 中的 to 是介词，后接名词或动名词，不接动词原形。

examples.en: I'm looking forward to hearing from you.

points.title: be worth doing 值得做
points.explanation_zh: sth. is worth doing，用主动形式表达被动含义，doing 后不再接宾语。

examples.en: This museum is worth visiting.

points.title: can't help doing 忍不住
points.explanation_zh: can't help doing 忍不住做某事；注意区分 can't help (to) do 不能帮忙做某事。

examples.en: I couldn't help laughing.

points.title: had better do 最好…
points.explanation_zh: had better + 动词原形，表示建议；否定式为 had better not do。

examples.en: You'd better take an umbrella.

points.title: Why not ...? 何不…？
points.explanation_zh: Why not + 动词原形 = Why don't you + 动词原形，表建议。

examples.en: Why not go for a walk?

points.title: What / How about ...? …怎么样？
points.explanation_zh: about 是介词，后接名词或动名词，用于提出建议或征求意见。

examples.en: What about playing basketball after school?

points.title: if 条件句：主将从现
points.explanation_zh: if 引导真实条件句时，主句用一般将来时，从句用一般现在时。if 还可引导虚拟条件句，表示与事实相反的假设。

examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
examples.zh: 如果明天下雨，我们就待在家里。

points.title: unless 除非 (= if ... not)
points.explanation_zh: unless 引导条件状语从句，相当于 if ... not；从句同样遵循主将从现。

examples.en: You'll miss the bus unless you hurry.
examples.zh: 除非你快点，否则你会错过公交车。

points.title: although 不与 but 连用
points.explanation_zh: although/though 引导让步状语从句，同一句中不能再用 but；同理 because 不与 so 连用。

examples.en: Although it was late, he kept working.
examples.zh: 虽然很晚了，他仍继续工作。

points.title: because 不与 so 连用
points.explanation_zh: because 引导原因状语从句，同一句中不能再用 so。回答 why 提问必须用 because。

examples.en: Because he was ill, he didn't come.

points.title: wish 后的虚拟语气
points.explanation_zh: wish 表示难以实现的愿望：对现在用过去时（be 用 were），对过去用过去完成时。注意与 hope（可实现的希望）区分。

examples.en: I wish I were taller.
I wish I had studied harder.
examples.zh: 我真希望当初更努力学习。

points.title: suggest 的宾语从句用 (should) do
points.explanation_zh: suggest / insist / demand / order 等词后的宾语从句用 should + 动词原形，should 可省略。suggest doing 也很常用。

examples.en: I suggest that he (should) see a doctor.

points.title: make / let / have sb. do 使役动词
points.explanation_zh: 使役动词 make / let / have 后接不带 to 的不定式；但被动语态中 to 要还原：be made to do。

examples.en: The teacher made us clean the classroom.

points.title: see sb. do / doing 感官动词
points.explanation_zh: 感官动词 see / hear / watch / notice 后接 do 表示看到全过程，接 doing 表示看到正在进行。

examples.en: I saw him cross the street.
examples.zh: 我看见他过了马路（全过程）。

examples.en: I saw him crossing the street.

points.title: in order to 为了
points.explanation_zh: in order to do 表目的，可置于句首或句中；否定式 in order not to do。

examples.en: He got up early in order to catch the first bus.
examples.zh: 为了赶上头班车，他起得很早。

points.title: be going to do 计划或即将发生
points.explanation_zh: be going to + 动词原形表示已经有计划的将来，或根据眼前迹象判断即将发生的事。

examples.en: I'm going to visit London next month.

points.title: 现在进行时 be doing
points.explanation_zh: am / is / are + doing 表示此刻正在进行，或当前阶段暂时持续的动作。

examples.en: I'm waiting for the train right now.

points.title: 现在完成时 have / has done
points.explanation_zh: have / has + 过去分词连接过去与现在，可表示经历、已经完成的结果或持续到现在的状态。

examples.en: I have already booked the tickets.

points.title: 现在完成进行时 have / has been doing
points.explanation_zh: 表示动作从过去开始，一直持续到现在，常强调持续时间或仍在进行。

examples.en: She has been studying English for two years.

points.title: 过去完成时 had done
points.explanation_zh: had + 过去分词表示在另一个过去时间或动作之前已经完成，常被称为“过去的过去”。

examples.en: The train had left before we arrived.
examples.zh: 我们到达前，火车已经开走了。

points.title: 被动语态 be done
points.explanation_zh: be + 过去分词强调动作的承受者；时态由 be 的形式承担，动作执行者可用 by 引出。

examples.en: The museum was built in 1890.
examples.zh: 这座博物馆建于 1890 年。

points.title: 情态动词 + 动词原形
points.explanation_zh: can、could、may、might、must、should、will、would 后接动词原形，可表达能力、可能、义务、建议或意愿。

examples.en: You should bring a light jacket.

points.title: 情态动词 + have done
points.explanation_zh: 情态动词 + have + 过去分词用于推测、评价或想象过去；should have done 常表示“本应该做却没有做”。

examples.en: We should have left earlier.

points.title: have to do 必须
points.explanation_zh: have to + 动词原形通常表示由规则或现实情况造成的客观必要；否定 don't have to 表示“不必”。

examples.en: I have to catch the last train.

points.title: be able to do 能够
points.explanation_zh: be able to + 动词原形表示能力，可用于 can 没有对应形式的时态或结构中。

examples.en: You'll be able to see the whole city from there.
examples.zh: 从那里你能看到整座城市。

points.title: be supposed to do 应该／按理要
points.explanation_zh: be supposed to 表示按规定、计划或普遍期待应该做某事，语气通常比 must 柔和。

examples.en: We're supposed to meet at the station at nine.
examples.zh: 我们按计划九点在车站见面。

points.title: be about to do 马上要
points.explanation_zh: be about to + 动词原形表示动作马上就要发生，一般不再搭配遥远的将来时间。

examples.en: The show is about to start.

points.title: be likely to do 很可能
points.explanation_zh: be likely to + 动词原形表示某人或某事很可能发生，可用 more / less likely 调整可能程度。

examples.en: It's likely to rain this afternoon.

points.title: would like to do 想要（礼貌）
points.explanation_zh: would like to 比 want to 更礼貌，常用于点餐、请求服务或表达愿望。

examples.en: I'd like to try the local dessert.

points.title: Would you mind ...? 介意……吗
points.explanation_zh: Would you mind 后接 doing，用于非常礼貌地请求；同意时通常回答 No, not at all。

examples.en: Would you mind taking a photo for us?
examples.zh: 你介意帮我们拍张照片吗？

points.title: Do you mind if ...? 介意我……吗
points.explanation_zh: Do you mind if I ...? 用于礼貌征求许可；mind 后的 if 从句说明希望做的事情。

examples.en: Do you mind if I sit here?

points.title: be used to doing 习惯于
points.explanation_zh: be used to 中的 to 是介词，后接名词、代词或 doing，表示已经习惯某事；不要与 used to do 混淆。

examples.en: I'm used to walking long distances.

points.title: get used to 逐渐习惯
points.explanation_zh: get used to 强调从不习惯到习惯的变化过程，to 后接名词、代词或 doing。

examples.en: You'll soon get used to the weather.
examples.zh: 你很快就会适应这里的天气。

points.title: be used for doing 被用于
points.explanation_zh: be used for + 名词或 doing 表示某物的用途；be used to do 也可表达“被用来做”。

examples.en: This card is used for entering the metro.

points.title: keep doing 持续做
points.explanation_zh: keep doing 表示持续或反复做同一件事；keep on doing 更强调反复不停。

examples.en: Keep practicing and you'll improve.

points.title: avoid doing 避免做
points.explanation_zh: avoid 后接名词或动名词 doing，不接 to do。

examples.en: Try to avoid traveling during rush hour.
examples.zh: 尽量避免在高峰期出行。

points.title: enjoy doing 喜欢做
points.explanation_zh: enjoy 后接名词或动名词 doing，表示从活动中获得乐趣，不接 to do。

examples.en: I enjoy exploring small neighborhoods.

points.title: finish doing 做完
points.explanation_zh: finish 后接名词或动名词 doing，表示完成某项活动，不接 to do。

examples.en: Let's leave after we finish eating.

points.title: consider doing 考虑做
points.explanation_zh: consider 表示“考虑”时后接名词或 doing；consider sb. to be 则表示“认为某人是”。

examples.en: We're considering staying another night.

points.title: feel like doing 想要做
points.explanation_zh: feel like 后接名词或 doing，表示当下想做某事，语气自然口语化。

examples.en: Do you feel like getting some coffee?

points.title: decide / plan / hope to do
points.explanation_zh: decide、plan、hope 后常接 to + 动词原形，分别表达决定、计划和希望去做某事。

examples.en: We decided to take the scenic route.
examples.zh: 我们决定走风景更好的路线。

points.title: manage to do 设法做到
points.explanation_zh: manage to do 表示经过努力最终成功完成，含有“并不容易”的意味。

examples.en: We managed to catch the last bus.
examples.zh: 我们设法赶上了末班车。

points.title: want sb. to do 希望某人做
points.explanation_zh: want + 人 + to do 表示希望某人采取某个动作；没有“人”时直接用 want to do。

examples.en: I want you to see this view.
examples.zh: 我想让你看看这里的景色。

points.title: ask sb. to do 请某人做
points.explanation_zh: ask + 人 + to do 表示请求某人做某事；ask for 后则接所请求的东西。

examples.en: I asked the driver to stop here.

points.title: tell sb. to do 告诉某人做
points.explanation_zh: tell + 人 + to do 表示告诉或吩咐某人做某事；否定式用 tell sb. not to do。

examples.en: She told me to keep the ticket.

points.title: allow sb. to do 允许某人做
points.explanation_zh: allow + 人 + to do 表示允许某人做某事；allow doing 可泛指允许某种行为。

examples.en: The pass allows you to enter all three museums.
examples.zh: 这张通票允许你进入三家博物馆。

points.title: prevent / stop sb. from doing 阻止
points.explanation_zh: prevent / stop + 人或事物 + from doing 表示阻止某动作发生；prevent 中的 from 通常不能省略。

examples.en: The rain didn't stop us from exploring.
examples.zh: 下雨没有阻止我们继续探索。

points.title: have trouble doing 做某事有困难
points.explanation_zh: have trouble / difficulty (in) doing 表示做某事有困难，in 经常省略。

examples.en: I had trouble finding the entrance.
examples.zh: 我费了些劲才找到入口。

points.title: be interested in 对……感兴趣
points.explanation_zh: be interested in 后接名词、代词或 doing，描述人的兴趣；interesting 则描述事物“有趣”。

examples.en: I'm interested in learning about local history.
examples.zh: 我对了解当地历史很感兴趣。

points.title: be good at 擅长
points.explanation_zh: be good at 后接名词或 doing，表示擅长某事；be good for 则表示“对……有益”。

examples.en: She's good at finding hidden cafés.
examples.zh: 她很擅长发现隐蔽的小咖啡馆。

points.title: be afraid of 害怕
points.explanation_zh: be afraid of 后接名词或 doing，表示害怕某事；be afraid to do 常表示因为害怕而不敢做。

examples.en: Don't be afraid of making mistakes.

points.title: look like 看起来像
points.explanation_zh: look like 后接名词或从句，表示外观或迹象相似；look + 形容词则直接描述状态。

examples.en: It looks like it's going to rain.

points.title: sound like 听起来像
points.explanation_zh: sound like 后接名词或从句，表示听到的信息给人的判断；sound + 形容词表示“听起来……”。

examples.en: That sounds like a great plan.
examples.zh: 那听起来是个很棒的计划。

points.title: because of 因为
points.explanation_zh: because of 是介词短语，后接名词、代词或 doing；because 是连词，后接完整句子。

examples.en: The flight was delayed because of the fog.

points.title: due to 由于
points.explanation_zh: due to 后接名词性成分说明原因，语气通常比 because of 更正式。

examples.en: The museum is closed due to maintenance.
examples.zh: 博物馆因维护暂停开放。

points.title: thanks to 多亏／由于
points.explanation_zh: thanks to 后接名词性成分，通常表示带来好结果的原因，有时也可带讽刺语气。

examples.en: Thanks to your directions, we found it easily.
examples.zh: 多亏你的指路，我们很容易就找到了。

points.title: in spite of 尽管
points.explanation_zh: in spite of 后接名词、代词或 doing，表示让步；although / though 后接完整句子。

examples.en: We went out in spite of the rain.
examples.zh: 尽管下雨，我们还是出门了。

points.title: even if 即使
points.explanation_zh: even if 引出假设性的让步条件，表示即使条件成立，主句结果也不会改变。

examples.en: I'll go even if it rains.

points.title: even though 尽管（事实）
points.explanation_zh: even though 引出已知事实并表示强烈让步；even if 更偏向假设情况。

examples.en: I enjoyed the walk even though it was cold.
examples.zh: 虽然天气很冷，我还是很享受这次散步。

points.title: as long as 只要
points.explanation_zh: as long as 引导条件从句，表示满足某个条件就可以；也可按字面表示“和……一样长”。

examples.en: You can stay as long as you keep quiet.
examples.zh: 只要你保持安静，就可以留下。

points.title: whether ... or not 是否／不管是否
points.explanation_zh: whether ... or not 表示两种可能都被考虑，可引导宾语从句或让步状语从句。

examples.en: We need to decide whether to go or not.

points.title: rather than 而不是
points.explanation_zh: rather than 连接两个平行成分，表示选择前者而不是后者；两边形式应尽量保持一致。

examples.en: Let's walk rather than take a taxi.
examples.zh: 我们走路吧，别坐出租车了。

points.title: instead of 代替／而不是
points.explanation_zh: instead of 后接名词、代词或 doing，表示用一种选择替代另一种。

examples.en: We took the metro instead of driving.
examples.zh: 我们坐了地铁，而不是开车。

points.title: as well as 也／以及
points.explanation_zh: as well as 连接并列成分并侧重前者；连接主语时，谓语通常与前面的主语保持一致。

examples.en: The ticket includes lunch as well as transport.
examples.zh: 票价包含交通，也包含午餐。

points.title: not ... until ... 直到……才
points.explanation_zh: not ... until 表示某动作在 until 指定的时间之前没有发生，中文常译为“直到……才……”。

examples.en: We didn't arrive until midnight.

points.title: by the time 到……的时候
points.explanation_zh: by the time 引导时间从句，主句常用完成时，强调到某个时间点之前已经发生或完成。

examples.en: By the time we arrived, the shop had closed.
examples.zh: 我们到的时候，商店已经关门了。

points.title: no matter + 疑问词 无论
points.explanation_zh: no matter what / who / where / how 等引导让步状语从句，表示条件怎样都不影响主句结果。

examples.en: Call me no matter what happens.
examples.zh: 无论发生什么都给我打电话。

points.title: in case 以防
points.explanation_zh: in case 引导预防性的从句，表示提前为某种可能做准备；不要与 if 的条件含义混用。

examples.en: Take an umbrella in case it rains.

points.title: so as to do 为了
points.explanation_zh: so as to + 动词原形表示目的，语气较正式；否定式是 so as not to do。

examples.en: We left early so as to avoid the crowds.
examples.zh: 我们早早离开，以避开人群。

points.title: according to 根据
points.explanation_zh: according to 后接信息来源或依据，一般不用于表达“按照我自己的看法”。

examples.en: According to the map, the station is nearby.
examples.zh: 根据地图，车站就在附近。

points.title: in addition to 除……之外还
points.explanation_zh: in addition to 后接名词、代词或 doing，用于补充额外信息；in addition 可单独作句子连接语。

examples.en: In addition to English, she speaks Spanish.
examples.zh: 除了英语，她还会说西班牙语。

points.title: There is no point (in) doing 做……没有意义
points.explanation_zh: There is no point (in) doing 表示做某事没有意义或不会产生效果，in 可以省略。

examples.en: There's no point worrying about it now.
examples.zh: 现在担心这件事也没有意义。

points.title: It is time to do 该做……了
points.explanation_zh: It is time to do 表示到了做某事的时候；It is time + 主语 + 过去式语气更强，表示早该做了。

examples.en: It's time to head back to the hotel.

points.title: How long ...? 多久／多长
points.explanation_zh: How long 可询问持续时间或物体长度；回答持续时间常用 for + 时间段。

examples.en: How long have you been in London?

points.title: How often ...? 多久一次
points.explanation_zh: How often 询问动作发生的频率，可用 once a week、sometimes、every day 等回答。

examples.en: How often do the buses run?
